name: Invisibility Liquor
summary: Invisibility Liquor gives Maybell Maclure a way to slip from her family's sight and meet Tommy Joe Stonefield. Their households are locked in a feud.

sections.title: A Potion for Star-Crossed Lovers
sections.body: Tommy Joe Stonefield seeks a quiet meeting with Maybell Maclure, though their families' feud keeps the households apart. Their kin watch closely, and ordinary secrecy is not enough. Invisibility Liquor lets the drinker pass unseen across the disputed farmland.

sections.title: Unorthodox Elwynn Alchemy
sections.body: Crystal Kelp Fronds from waters where murlocs dwell go into the brew. When Maybell Maclure drinks it, she vanishes from sight and slips into the woods for a secret meeting.

faq.answer: Invisibility Liquor is an alcoholic drink with magic that makes the drinker invisible for a short time.
Maybell Maclure receives Invisibility Liquor so she can leave her family's sight and meet Tommy Joe Stonefield, despite their households' feud.
The liquor is brewed with Crystal Kelp Fronds gathered from riverbeds and lake shores in Elwynn Forest, where murlocs hoard the plants.

faq.q: Can players drink the Invisibility Liquor themselves?
faq.answer: No. Invisibility Liquor is meant for delivery to Maybell Maclure, so she can slip away from her family.

angles.text: As a mage, you know the Kirin Tor arcanists spend years mastering illusions and invisibility spells. Elwynn locals make a rough imitation with fermented spirits and waterlogged kelp.
As a human, you know the Stonefield and Maclure clans' rural feud reaches bitter extremes.
